title: Extremely limited without subscription
body: It was cute at first, but you can see they are already making money from the unavoidable ads, then with the little figments you save up to get the items you can't even use them for any of the options because you need to pay the subscription service. I thought the items had both the Ultimate symbol and the figment symbol to indicate it can be added to your room with either subscription or with saving up your figments but no. A bit greedy. And gets so boring fast with so little options, unfortunately not much reason to continue using it.
author: jbarajas3

title: Mi favorita 🩵
body: La conocí hace 18 meses, todo lo que brinda, es muy aplicativo al día a día, los gráficos son súper tiernos🥰, y aún así los puedes personalizar a tus gustos 😌amo las cartas del día, he llorado mucho, y me motivan demasiado, gracias a Roubit, mi vida es más linda ✨🩵

title: LA MEJOR ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
